ambiguity_evidence.fact: Well class appears only on invoice headers (the contractor's statement); no call-off is in the data.
The adjustment column is 0.00 on every invoice; invoices carry an invoice date but no submission date.
Reports state whole circulating and back-reaming hours per day; some Standby days record circulating hours.
Each report has one signature block (Company Representative, lead directional driller) after its last part; Parts B-E carry no signatures of their own.
Reports list tools and crew in rig words; no report field carries a service code.
Part E states circulating hours accumulated on the well at the loss. Compared with sums of daily circulating hours up to and including the day of loss.
Part B states metres logged and reamed per run. Compared with the sum of daily depth advances over the run's reports.
